messages:
rachel-sales: Quick align for AcmeBank POC. They want document search + conversational Q&A, plus a couple of live tool calls (balance fetch, txn lookup). Need success criteria and a 3-week plan. Can we scope now?

dan-eng: OK. Two clarifying q's: target context per user query (docs combined) and expected concurrency for load tests? Also confirm if they expect function/tool calling to modify state or read-only calls.

peter-cust: Context ~25-35k tokens per query (documents + prompt). Concurrent users small for POC, ~5 qps peak. Tool calls are read-only for POC. Latency goal: 1s for short answers, 2.5s for heavy context.

maya-solutions: Draft success criteria: (A) MRR >= 0.6 on 50 eval queries; (B) NDCG@10 >= 0.75; (C) tool-call success 98% for sample set; (D) avg P95 latency <= 2.2s under test load. If agreed we'll build eval harness and runner.

dan-eng: Model plan: use 32k-capable model variant. Host quantized instance for cost. RAG pipeline: embed docs -> FAISS/IVF index -> retrieve top 100 -> rerank with lightweight cross-encoder or pairwise scorer. Precompute embeddings for static docs. For tool calling, expose a validated JSON RPC with a 400ms soft timeout, fallback message when timed out.

rachel-sales: Pricing/ops note: POC estimate (3 weeks + a small dedicated burst for load): $10k-$15k. If they sign an annual Dedicated plan we can apply credit. I'll finalize a ballpark.

sec-bot: Security flags: require SOC2 statement, confirm no regulated data (no PHI), KMS for keys if customer needs private mode, and a 72-hr review for questionnaire. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/questionnaire-v3

maya-solutions: Eval details: we'll run a 100-query graded set (0/1/2) and 40 hallucination-sensitive prompts. Metrics: MRR, Recall@10, NDCG@10, and hallucination rate. We'll provide the notebook and a sample rerank request payload.

```
POST /api/v1/rerank
{
  "query": "recent overdraft policy changes",
  "candidates": ["doc_22", "doc_345"],
  "k": 10
}
```

dan-eng: Dev tasks: provision 32k instance, build FAISS index with incremental update, implement tool-call stub + timeout/fallback, wire simple dashboard (tokens, latencies, errors). I can start provisioning today if I get env access.

rachel-sales: Action items: maya to share eval harness and notebook by EOD; dan to spin up infra and share endpoints; sec-bot to send questionnaire link; I'll send POC quote and schedule kickoff for tomorrow 11am PT.

peter-cust: Thanks all — we'll assemble gold queries and share docs by tomorrow morning. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

rachel-sales: Great. I'll loop back with calendar invite. :rocket:
